Looking for underrated trilogies and movie collections that people never talk about? In this video, I’m reviewing a mix of hidden gem trilogies, overlooked movie series, and even a few unofficial “trinities” from legendary directors like Brian De Palma, David Fincher... even Taylor Sheridan has a Modern Western Trinity.

These aren’t your typical blockbuster trilogies either. No Lord of the Rings, no Star Wars. This list focuses on movies that flew under the radar, including crime, action, thriller, and international picks that deserve way more attention.
